places.name: Indian Territory
places.note: The herd crosses it amid talk of Indians; near its northern edge Call gives a lame steer to hungry Wichitas led by an old acquaintance.

places.name: Kansas
places.note: On its southern edge a grasshopper cloud strips the grass; Gus and Lorena shelter in their tent, and young Indians guide a lost Newt back.

places.name: Blue Mounds
places.note: Low rolling hills to the north that look bluish at dusk and dawn but turn out plain brown by daylight.
places.location_hint: humped low hills just north of the herd, near the southern edge of Kansas after leaving Indian Territory

places.name: Santa Fe
places.note: Lippy says he traded west of there, learned piano, and got the hole in his stomach from an Apache.

places.name: Republican River
places.note: Jasper refuses a fortune for fear of learning he will drown in it.

places.name: New Orleans
places.note: Old women there told Augustus's fortune several times, always the same dull one.

places.name: Arkansas
places.note: Augustus reflects that one card-game shot there set off a chain of deaths and troubles.

places.name: Montana
places.note: The drive's goal, still nowhere in sight.

places.name: Ogallala
places.note: Lorena frets because Gus has told her a woman he cares for is there.

groups.label: Hat Creek herd
groups.hint: on grasshopper-stripped plain just inside southern Kansas near the Blue Mounds; Indians say it is sixty miles to water due north

groups.label: Augustus and Lorena
groups.hint: in their tent camp a few miles behind the herd on the southern edge of Kansas
